mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainer_identity_oauth_client_binding (id, principal_id, client_id, status, bound_at, unbound_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{principalId}, #{clientId}, #{status}, #{boundAt}, #{unboundAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, principal_id, client_id, status, bound_at, unbound_at FROM ainer_identity_oauth_client_binding WHERE client_id = #{clientId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, principal_id, client_id, status, bound_at, unbound_at FROM ainer_identity_oauth_client_binding WHERE principal_id = #{principalId} ORDER BY bound_at DESC LIMIT 1
